items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, sure. Thanks Amar, what happened at the Dallas State Fair?

ctx.x: I come up with him. Yeah. Sure, I came up with Nat Toys. Where's he from, what part of the family? Uptown. What we call Uptown from Dallantown.
Yeah, sure. Thanks Amar, what happened at the Dallas State Fair?
In what regard? Well I mean I don't. That was the beginning of my band.
